summary: Concrete registry of ItemDefinitions, so id-to-asset lookup works at load time.
overview: A concrete subclass of the generic data registry, which exists because Unity does not allow [CreateAssetMenu] on a generic type. Its job is turning a saved string id back into the ItemDefinition asset it names.
useCases: Resolving a save file's item ids back into assets on load.
Looking an item up by id from a loot table or console command.

gotchas.title: Items must be listed in it to be findable
gotchas.body: It is an explicit list, not an automatic scan. An item missing from the registry loads as nothing, with no error.
